criteria.requirement: Implement chardet.validated.detect_validated(data, *, validator=None). Snapshot bytes, obtain real detect_all candidates, stable-sort confidence, deduplicate supported codec aliases and strictly decode the entire payload for every candidate before an optional (text, candidate) callback. Return selected original facts and per-candidate accepted/business-rejected/decode-error/unsupported-codec statuses without returning full text. All-rejected/empty/unsupported results must not claim whole validation; callback errors propagate and confidence is never fabricated or represented as an accuracy guarantee.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
